subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notices that the fire comes from a device the Duergar are holding, a tube that connects to a bottle on their back, with a small flame sitting outside the tube, produced by a magic concoction lit by a tiny flame when the Duergar operator pulls a lever.
source_quote: Grygum notices that the fire comes from a device they are holding. It is a tube that connects to a bottle on their back. At the front of the tube, a small flame sits outside the tube. He realizes that the flame is produced from some kind of magic concoction lit by the tiny flame when the duergar operator pulls a lever.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouts, 'Don’t kill him! There’s something wrong with this giant! Let’s try and subdue him.'
source_quote: “Don’t kill him! There’s something wrong with this giant! Let’s try and subdue him,” shouts Thorin.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz’s hands emit a few bolts of magic.
source_quote: A few bolts of magic streak from Daz’s hands.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thinks, 'Well, I guess Daz chose to weaken his spell purposely.'
source_quote: Grygum looks at Daz, and then looks at the giant, and thinks, “Well, I guess Daz chose to weaken his spell purposely.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum hears from within the darkness the sound of Zalthir’s fists hitting the giant and the blade of Thorin, but still, the giant stands.
source_quote: Grygum hears from within the darkness the sound of Zalthir’’s fists hitting the giant and the blade of Thorin, but still, the giant stands.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum rushes in to strike with his mace.
source_quote: So Grygum rushes in to strike with his mace.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum watches as a distraught Thorin whispers prayers for the dead.
source_quote: Grygum watches as a distraught Thorin whispers prayers for the dead.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: The Duergar, unconvinced by Thorin’s entreaties, kill the giant.
source_quote: The Duergar, unconvinced by Thorin’s entreaties, kill the giant.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: The enlarged Duergars have shrunk to their standard size.
source_quote: Grygum looks up, and the enlarged Duergars have shrunk to their standard size.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin turns to one of the Duergar, 'Are there more crazy people about?'
source_quote: He turns to one of the Duergar, “Are there more crazy people about?”

subject: Guard
fact: The guard sensing that asks, 'Someone who does not follow orders and engages in anti-social behavior, but does it in a way that will bring them no profit and certain doom?'
source_quote: The guard sensing that asks, “Someone who does not follow orders and engages in anti-social behavior, but does it in a way that will bring them no profit and certain doom?”

subject: Duergar
fact: The Duergar turns to the others on his patrol, briefly discusses, and says, 'We have noticed that there have been significantly more incidents of this kind of behavior. As a result, the work of the militias has increased.'
source_quote: The Duergar turns to the others on his patrol, briefly discusses, and says, “We have noticed that there have been significantly more incidents of this kind of behavior. As a result, the work of the militias has increased.”

subject: Duergar
fact: The Duergar says, 'And we know of no underlying cause. Although a clan leader may have information they have chosen not to share with us.'
source_quote: There is a pause, “And we know of no underlying cause. Although a clan leader may have information they have chosen not to share with us.”

subject: Stone Giant
fact: The Stone Giant stares at Thorin, whose body and blade show that he fought and perhaps killed the two-headed giant.
source_quote: The Stone Giant stares at Thorin, whose body and blade show that he fought and perhaps killed the two-headed giant.

subject: Stone Giant
fact: The Stone Giant says, 'I am Dorhun, and this is Rihuud. We were both apprentices to Stonespeaker Hgraam. Did you kill him?'
source_quote: The Stone Giant doesn’t smile, “No. But then again, I don’t know many. Who are you?” ... Then he says, “I am Dorhun, and this is Rihuud. We were both apprentices to Stonespeaker Hgraam. Did you kill him?”

subject: Stone Giant
fact: The Stone Giant says, 'We have qualified immunity if a Stone Giant is rampaging through our city.'
source_quote: “We have qualified immunity if a Stone Giant is rampaging through our city,” one explains.

subject: Stone Giant
fact: The Stone Giant says, 'I ask you to visit me at Cairngorm Cavern before you leave the city.'
source_quote: Then he says, “I ask you to visit me at Cairngorm Cavern before you leave the city.”

subject: Stone Giant
fact: The Stone Giant says to the Duergar with the stone weapons, 'Stone Guards, you are to let them through.'
source_quote: Turning to the Duergar with the stone weapons, he says, “Stone Guards, you are to let them through.”

subject: Duergar
fact: The Duergar gives the Stone Giant the briefest of scowls, showing how much they don’t want to give this non-Duergar permission to visit their city.
source_quote: The dwarf watches how the Duergar gives the Stone Giant the briefest of scowls, showing how much they don’t want to give this non-Duergar permission to visit their city.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks, 'I gotta get me some of that ability.'
source_quote: “I gotta get me some of that ability,” he thinks.

subject: Gartokkar Xundorn
fact: Gartokkar Xundorn says, 'I am the Custodian of the Flame, the chief of the Keepers of the Flame, who tend to Themberchaud’s needs.'
source_quote: “I am the Custodian of the Flame, the chief of the Keepers of the Flame, who tend to Themberchaud’s needs.”

subject: Gartokkar Xundorn
fact: Gartokkar Xundorn says, 'The furnaces of Gracklstugh must be kept hot, and instead of using a large amount of kindling, we use a fire dragon that burns stone hot that then is used to keep the furnaces running.'
source_quote: “The furnaces of Gracklstugh must be kept hot, and instead of using a large amount of kindling, we use a fire dragon that burns stone hot that then is used to keep the furnaces running.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asks while holding down a snigger, 'So he’s a lighter?'
source_quote: Zalthir hears Daz ask while holding down a snigger, “So he’s a lighter?”

subject: Gartokkar Xundorn
fact: Gartokkar Xundorn says, 'Yes. The Keepers of the Flame tend to the dragon’s needs. And we are the most prized of the Deepking’s advisors. We need someone like you.'
source_quote: Gartokkar is a Duergar, and he is literal and misses the sarcasm, “Yes. The Keepers of the Flame tend to the dragon’s needs. And we are the most prized of the Deepking’s advisors. We need someone like you.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum jokes, 'We do have some kindling here.'
source_quote: Zalthir hears Grygum’s joke, “We do have some kindling here.”

subject: Gartokkar Xundorn
fact: Gartokkar Xundorn says, 'Your skill set would be of great value to the city of Gracklstugh. If you were to come to the Keepers of the Flame headquarters and do me a service, I could give you safe passage through the city. And as long as you did nothing that the Deepking would disapprove of and would not require me to do too much, I could keep you out of the prisons.'
source_quote: “Your skill set would be of great value to the city of Gracklstugh. If you were to come to the Keepers of the Flame headquarters and do me a service, I could give you safe passage through the city. And as long as you did nothing that the Deepking would disapprove of and would not require me to do too much, I could keep you out of the prisons.”

subject: Gartokkar Xundorn
fact: Gartokkar Xundorn says, 'The offer expires tomorrow. And if you don’t accept the offer, I cannot promise we will be so friendly when we meet next.'
source_quote: There is a moment of hesitation, “The offer expires tomorrow. And if you don’t accept the offer, I cannot promise we will be so friendly when we meet next.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wonders, 'How does a dragon end up turning into a lighter? What’s in it for him? Red dragons are not exactly known for their willingness to serve. They want to build a hoard or something. A dragon that flies around lighting fires is odd.'
source_quote: The story of this dragon intrigues Daz. “How does a dragon end up turning into a lighter? What’s in it for him? Red dragons are not exactly known for their willingness to serve. They want to build a hoard or something. A dragon that flies around lighting fires is odd.”

subject: Halfling
fact: The halfling says, 'It all began with the Deepking’s madness.'
source_quote: “It all began with the Deepking’s madness.”

subject: Halfling
fact: The halfling says, 'Now, they don’t. It’s as if he is detached from reality.'
source_quote: Now, they don’t. It’s as if he is detached from reality.

subject: Halfling
fact: The halfling says, 'You must have met the Keepers of the Flame? They are in a pickle, what with the Gray Ghosts and the Crown.'
source_quote: “You must have met the Keepers of the Flame? They are in a pickle, what with the Gray Ghosts and the Crown.”

subject: Halfling
fact: The halfling says, 'I’m an outsider. And what do I know? Not very much. And as long as I stay an outsider, no one considers me a threat. And I can share what I know with those not in the game. And you are not part of the game, nor am I.'
source_quote: “I’m an outsider. And what do I know? Not very much. And as long as I stay an outsider, no one considers me a threat. And I can share what I know with those not in the game. And you are not part of the game, nor am I.”

subject: Halfling
fact: The halfling says, 'What is that expression? It's -- Not relevant to the game.'
source_quote: He pauses, searching for a phrase, “What is that expression? It's -- Not relevant to the game.”

subject: Halfling
fact: The halfling says, 'The red dragon keeps the stones hot enough for the furnaces to burn. Are you wondering about its horde? The keepers of the flame give him a horde, and they pamper him. The problem, and you’re right to wonder, is that Red Dragons dislike playing second fiddle. And so, at some point, the Dragon discovers it’s not in charge. Then, the Keepers of the Flame have to kill the dragon. There is also the problem of the dragon becoming more powerful over time. So the Keepers must kill and replace the dragon with a new one.'
source_quote: “The red dragon keeps the stones hot enough for the furnaces to burn. Are you wondering about its horde? The keepers of the flame give him a horde, and they pamper him. The problem, and you’re right to wonder, is that Red Dragons dislike playing second fiddle. And so, at some point, the Dragon discovers it’s not in charge. Then, the Keepers of the Flame have to kill the dragon. There is also the problem of the dragon becoming more powerful over time. So the Keepers must kill and replace the dragon with a new one.”

subject: Drow
fact: The Drow says, 'Look, friend, I am from Menzoberranzan. The backstabbing and politicking are nothing compared to the Duergar. I mean, we will do it with style and finesse. Here, it’s just slaughter. No torture, no speeches, no art, and I mean no style. It was just a brutal struggle. They just engage in violence for violence’s sake. It’s disgraceful if you ask me.'
source_quote: At this point, the Drow sitting next to the Halfling splutters, “Look, friend, I am from Menzoberranzan. The backstabbing and politicking are nothing compared to the Duergar. I mean, we will do it with style and finesse. Here, it’s just slaughter. No torture, no speeches, no art, and I mean no style. It was just a brutal struggle. They just engage in violence for violence’s sake. It’s disgraceful if you ask me.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'It’s just a friendly meeting. Not that kind of meeting!'
source_quote: Thorin grabs his sword and wonders where exactly they will run to because it’s not clear how they can beat the entire stone guard, but the effect Daz was hoping for is achieved. Errde is taken aback and smiles, “Of course not. It is a friendly conversation.” ... Thorin shouts, “It’s just a friendly meeting. Not that kind of meeting!”

subject: Errde Blackskull
fact: Errde Blackskull says, 'I have been tracking a particular Duergar named Droki. He lives in the West Cleft District, where the Derro live. If we were to go there in force, it would provoke a violent reaction. So we need someone who isn’t us to find him.'
source_quote: “I have been tracking a particular Duergar named Droki. He lives in the West Cleft District, where the Derro live. If we were to go there in force, it would provoke a violent reaction. So we need someone who isn’t us to find him.”

subject: Errde Blackskull
fact: Errde Blackskull says, 'There is something very wrong going on in my city. Some kind of corruption eats at the heart of the Deepking’s court. Droki is the key to uncovering that corruption. He is linked to the Council of Savants and maybe even elements of the Clan Lairds. Discovery of this conspiracy will earn me great favor with the Deepking. And when that happens, I swear you will get free and safe passage out of the city.'
source_quote: “There is something very wrong going on in my city. Some kind of corruption eats at the heart of the Deepking’s court. Droki is the key to uncovering that corruption. He is linked to the Council of Savants and maybe even elements of the Clan Lairds. Discovery of this conspiracy will earn me great favor with the Deepking. And when that happens, I swear you will get free and safe passage out of the city.”

subject: Errde Blackskull
fact: Errde Blackskull says, 'It is my job to protect the city from corruption. So yes, it is for the city.'
source_quote: “It is my job to protect the city from corruption. So yes, it is for the city.”

subject: Errde Blackskull
fact: Errde Blackskull says, 'Things were not proceeding according to the rules of the market, of the bazaar. It starts with not obeying the rules. Then it proceeds to grift, then chaos, and then destruction.'
source_quote: Errde smiles, “Things were not proceeding according to the rules of the market, of the bazaar. It starts with not obeying the rules. Then it proceeds to grift, then chaos, and then destruction.”

subject: Errde Blackskull
fact: Errde Blackskull says, 'As a reward, I offer you 175 gold pieces of equipment from our armory. When you bring me Droki and the proof I need, then I will give you 175 more.'
source_quote: “As a reward, I offer you 175 gold pieces of equipment from our armory. When you bring me Droki and the proof I need, then I will give you 175 more.”

subject: Errde Blackskull
fact: Errde Blackskull says, 'And I can offer one more thing. If a particular group of Drow were to come looking for some escaped slaves, I could tell them that they are not here. As you think about which group to work with, remember I am the one that can guarantee your freedom.'
source_quote: She then smiles very evilly, “And I can offer one more thing.” ... “If a particular group of Drow were to come looking for some escaped slaves, I could tell them that they are not here. As you think about which group to work with, remember I am the one that can guarantee your freedom.”
